title: Explain my allocation
purpose: Explain concentration and compare the saved allocation with equal weights using recorded evidence.
required: A saved allocation with a calculation receipt

title: Test a holding cap
purpose: Recalculate one holding-cap change with the same dataset, training window and evaluation dates; do not save or trade.
required: A saved allocation and a feasible cap

title: Check a long-term goal
purpose: Use the saved weights in the existing simulation engine and explain the actual real-wealth goal and drawdown.
required: A saved allocation, real-dollar goal and horizon
